help.title: Help
help.qs_step1_desc: Click the + button or drag files to import Markdown, TXT, PDF, HTML files into your knowledge base.
help.qs_step2_desc: Open Settings (⌘,) and enter your API Key and Base URL. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works.
help.qs_step3_desc: Type your question in the input box. AI answers based on your knowledge base documents.
help.qs_step4_desc: Each answer shows reference sources. Click to view the original document chunks.
help.faq_q1: How do I configure my LLM?
help.faq_a1: Open Settings (⌘,) and enter your API Key, Base URL, and model name. Any OpenAI-compatible API works (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.).
help.faq_a2: Markdown (.md), Text (.txt), PDF (.pdf), HTML (.html), Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), and EPUB (.epub).
help.faq_a3: All data stays locally on your device in the app data directory. Nothing is sent to any server except your LLM API calls.
help.faq_a4: Go to Settings → License and enter your Pro license key. Pro unlocks: unlimited documents, PDF import, local LLM, OCR, and more.
help.faq_a5: EchoMind uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dimensional, ~30MB) by default. It runs locally via ONNX Runtime. Pro users can upload custom models.
help.faq_a6: Database encryption uses SQLCipher (AES-256). Your password is derived via Argon2id KDF. The database is transparently encrypted at rest.
help.privacy_local: All your documents, embeddings, and conversations are stored locally on your device. No data is sent to any external server.
help.privacy_llm: When you ask a question, only your query and relevant document chunks are sent to your configured LLM API endpoint. No other data leaves your device.
help.privacy_encryption: Database encryption (SQLCipher AES-256) protects your data at rest. Your password never leaves your device.
help.privacy_pii: PII detection can automatically identify and redact 8 types of sensitive information (email, phone, ID card, bank card, IP, SSN, passport, international phone).
help.privacy_audit: Audit logging uses a tamper-evident hash chain. Any modification to audit logs is detectable via chain verification.
help.privacy_noproxy: The application does not use any proxy. All network connections are direct. You can verify this in the source code — every reqwest client uses .no_proxy().
